ggchord.examples:
ggchord(data = seqs) +
  geom_seq() + geom_gene(data = genes) + coord_collinear()

ggchord() +
  geom_seq(data = seqs) + geom_gene(data = genes) + coord_chord()

# 有参考即可绘制观察层，不必显示骨架
ggchord(data = seqs) + geom_gene(data = genes) + coord_collinear()

ggchord_data.usage:
ggchord_data(sequences, features = list(), links = list(),
             tracks = list(), alignments = list())
ggchord_data.examples:
d <- ggchord_data(seqs,
  features = list(genes = genes), links = list(blast = links))
ggchord(d$sequences) + geom_seq() +
  geom_gene(data = d$features$genes) +
  geom_link_ribbon(data = d$links$blast)

layer_id.examples:
ggchord(seqs) + geom_seq() +
  layer_id(geom_point(data = data.frame(x = 0, y = 0),
    aes(x, y), inherit.aes = FALSE), "canvas_points")

coord_chord.usage:
coord_chord(
  start_angle = 0, direction = "counterclockwise",
  xlim = NULL, ylim = NULL, expand = FALSE,
  clip = "on", fit = "geometry"
)
coord_chord.examples:
ggchord(data = seqs) +
  geom_seq() +
  geom_gene(data = genes, aes(fill = type)) +
  geom_link_ribbon(data = links) +
  coord_chord(start_angle = 90)

coord_circular.usage:
coord_circular(
  start_angle = 0, direction = "clockwise",
  xlim = NULL, ylim = NULL, expand = FALSE,
  clip = "on", fit = "geometry"
)
coord_circular.examples:
circular_seq <- data.frame(
  accver = "A", length = 1000, sequence_unit = "bp", topology = "circular"
)
ggchord(circular_seq) +
  geom_seq() +
  geom_seq_center_label(aes(label = accver), size = 5) +
  layout_sequences(angular_gap = 12) +
  coord_circular(start_angle = 90)

coord_collinear.usage:
coord_collinear(
  axis = "x", ratio = NULL,
  xlim = NULL, ylim = NULL, expand = FALSE,
  clip = "on", fit = "geometry"
)
coord_collinear.examples:
ggchord(data = seqs) +
  geom_seq() +
  geom_gene(data = genes) +
  geom_link_ribbon(data = links) +
  layout_sequences(
    orientation = c(A = 1, B = -1),
    curvature = c(A = 0.4, B = -0.3)
  ) +
  coord_collinear(axis = "x")

facet_null.examples:
ggchord(seqs) + geom_seq() + geom_gene(data = genes) +
  coord_collinear() + facet_null()

facet_wrap.usage:
ggplot2::facet_wrap(
  facets, nrow = NULL, ncol = NULL, scales = "fixed", space = "fixed",
  shrink = TRUE, labeller = "label_value", as.table = TRUE,
  switch = deprecated(), drop = TRUE, dir = "h",
  strip.position = "top", axes = "margins", axis.labels = "all"
)
facet_wrap.examples:
# 每条序列一个圆形面板；两张表均明确包含accver
ggchord(seqs) + geom_seq() + geom_gene(data = genes) +
  coord_circular() + facet_wrap(vars(accver))

facet_grid.usage:
ggplot2::facet_grid(
  rows = NULL, cols = NULL, scales = "fixed", space = "fixed",
  shrink = TRUE, labeller = "label_value", as.table = TRUE,
  switch = NULL, drop = TRUE, margins = FALSE,
  axes = "margins", axis.labels = "all", facets = deprecated()
)
facet_grid.examples:
g <- genes
g$sample <- c("s1", "s2", "s1")
ggchord(seqs) + geom_seq() + geom_gene(data = g) +
  coord_collinear() + facet_grid(cols = vars(sample))

layout_sequences.usage:
layout_sequences(
  order = NULL, orientation = 1, length_mode = "proportional",
  angular_gap = NULL, row_gap = NULL, segment_gap = NULL,
  column_gap = NULL, radius = NULL, inner_radius = NULL,
  curvature = NULL, align = NULL, anchor = NULL, windows = NULL
)
layout_sequences.examples:
ggchord(data = seqs) +
  geom_seq() +
  geom_gene(data = genes) +
  layout_sequences(
    order = c("B", "A"), orientation = c(A = 1, B = -1),
    align = "center", curvature = c(A = 0.4, B = -0.3)
  ) +
  coord_collinear()

# 同一来源显示两个窗口，不重新计算源统计
w <- data.frame(instance_id = c("A_left", "A_right"),
                accver = "A", start = c(1, 501), end = c(500, 1000),
                row_id = "A_split")
ggchord(data = one_seq) + geom_seq() +
  layout_sequences(windows = w, segment_gap = 3) + coord_collinear()

layout_dotplot.usage:
layout_dotplot(
  x_order = NULL, y_order = NULL,
  x_orientation = 1, y_orientation = 1,
  x_gap = 0, y_gap = 0
)
layout_dotplot.examples:
ggchord(data = seqs) +
  geom_alignment_segment(data = links) +
  layout_dotplot(x_order = "A", y_order = "B", y_orientation = -1) +
  coord_dotplot()

suggest_sequence_layout.usage:
suggest_sequence_layout(
  sequences, links, order = NULL, reference = NULL,
  weight = "aligned_length", min_support = 0.1
)
suggest_sequence_layout.examples:
suggestion <- suggest_sequence_layout(seqs, links, weight = "count")
suggestion$evidence
ggchord(data = seqs) + geom_seq() + geom_link_ribbon(data = links) +
  do.call(layout_sequences, suggestion$layout) + coord_collinear()

setup:
library(ggplot2)
library(ggchord)

seqs <- data.frame(
  accver = c("A", "B"), length = c(1000, 800),
  sequence_unit = "bp", topology = "linear"
)
one_seq <- seqs[1, , drop = FALSE]
genes <- data.frame(
  accver = c("A", "A", "B"), feature_id = c("g1", "g2", "g3"),
  start = c(100, 400, 150), end = c(240, 620, 380),
  strand = c("+", "-", "+"), label = c("g1", "g2", "g3"),
  type = c("CDS", "tRNA", "CDS")
)
links <- data.frame(
  qaccver = "A", saccver = "B", qstart = c(100, 400),
  qend = c(240, 620), sstart = c(150, 450), send = c(290, 650),
  qstrand = "+", sstrand = c("+", "-"),
  pident = c(98, 90), link_id = c("l1", "l2")
)
points <- data.frame(qaccver = "A", qpos = 200, saccver = "B", spos = 220)
sites <- data.frame(accver = "A", pos = 300, site_id = "s1", label = "EcoRI")
signal <- data.frame(accver = rep(c("A", "B"), each = 3),
  pos = rep(c(100, 400, 700), 2), value = c(2, 5, 3, 1, 4, 2))
unordered_signal <- signal[c(1, 3, 2, 4, 6, 5), ]
intervals <- genes[c("accver", "start", "end")]
states <- genes[c("accver", "start", "end", "type")]
gene_colours <- c(CDS = "#187B77", tRNA = "#CC7D3A")
windows <- data.frame(accver = "A", start = 1, end = 500, window_id = "w1")
p_basic <- ggchord(seqs) + geom_seq() +
  geom_gene(data = genes) + coord_collinear()

label_seq <- data.frame(accver = "A", length = 1000, sequence_unit = "bp")
crowded_genes <- data.frame(
  accver = "A",
  feature_id = c("g1", "g2", "g3"),
  start = c(425, 478, 531),
  end = c(467, 520, 573),
  strand = "+",
  label = c("Gene alpha", "Gene beta", "Gene gamma")
)
label_plot <- ggchord(label_seq) +
  geom_seq() +
  geom_gene(data = crowded_genes, fill = "#187B77") +
  coord_collinear()
